display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 同包双扰动细节保持
description: 共享双阶段 DURA 与实增益融合，比较同一网络上的波形损失与 Clean 锚定的弱频谱和复数差分一致性损失。
authorization: Current user LoRa and WiSig fusion objective and small screening before any complete target release.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32, separate CPU scorer

data.dataset: IEEE DataPort multi-receiver LoRa and WiSig/ManySig Main split
data.version: lora_full_packets_v1; WiSig registered R17/WiSig Main source cache
data.representation: LoRa complex 8192 at 1 MS/s -> original W24. WiSig complex 256 -> original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
data.contract_ref: LoRa parent frozen source contract.json; WiSig 20261019-phase1-reception-restoration-selfsup-manysig-m6-r02/cache/complete.json
data.physical_ids_ref: 160 each, LoRa b200_1 and WiSig physical RX4 fixed before predictions. All four previous panels excluded blindly, plus the older 300-ID LoRa panel. Historical source V mother-panel exposure remains.
data.label_map_ref: Original frozen E104 (10) and WiSig Main seed 2026092701 (6); independent scorer only.
data.validation_ref: Reuse registered validates-once source handles and fixed physical panels.
data.leo_config_ref: Only clean and the previously registered source Full practical_low_urban. Targets and other five views are outside this release.

permissions.claim_scope: Training frozen DURA and real-gain experts with new gates only, uses lawful U_s IQ and two independent generic synthetic disturbances. Neither U true TX, V, target, nor classifier weights/outputs read by fit. Clean anchor only from the same U_s source packet.

checkpoint.initialization: Same StageGain frequency-wise architecture and identical random initialization for both objective arms. No inherited gate or target-specific parameters. Frozen DURA and gain experts only.

sources.role: Same 266,951-parameter LoRa-native R69 topology trained on LoRa source U_s from scratch, fixed at 18,000 steps
Original 266,951-parameter WiSig R69 and default deployment graph
Standalone LoRa native gain baseline; E104 reader frozen
Standalone WiSig gain baseline from source-only 8k U_s fit; original frozen Tri-SIG-TIME default reader
复用冻结 WiSig RX3 五条预测；LoRa 从未完成预测。

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Strict frozen checkpoint load and actual no-query U_s smoke on both datasets.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Portable solver and exact same DURA topology and call order; dataset-native windows and legal checkpoints.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed step 3200. Primary paired-detail candidate needs +8/160 or more and positive 95% paired lower bound against direct, DURA and real gain individually, with Clean at least best among original controls. Matched waveform arm used to identify loss effect. Full only after qualified result and separately fixed full matrix.

execution.launch_owner: Current LoRa performance chat, dual dataset objective
execution.gpu_policy: N607 card eligibility [0,2,3,5,7], at least 12288 MiB free and fewer than eight existing compute contexts. One worker per used card. Preserve every other owner.
execution.stop_rule: Stop scoring on failed U_s gradient or real checkpoint no-query smoke, nonfinite fit or mismatched panel. No target access. 3200 steps per arm and separate CPU truth-last.

dimensions: source V one receiver per dataset
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261128-phase1-lora-wisig-gain-dura-paired-detail-s2026113071-r01/scores.json, changes and gate source-only with separate truth-last

rows.method: Paired detail loss and matched two-view waveform loss, both with same frequency-wise in-stage gain
rows.seed_notes: Identical optimizer, initialization, source ordering and two independent disturbances shared across fit arms. Training/validation seeds fixed. Prediction only one observation.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, gradient norm 1 for each arm
rows.lr: Cosine 3e-4 to 3e-5, two independent arms same IQ batches
rows.budget_ref: Same 3200 steps per arm, batch8 physical source U_s packets, 2 views per packet. Baseline mean of the prior IQ/adjacent IQ/frequency/intermediate-stage objective. Candidate .20 times baseline plus .80 times complex spectral/differential detail anchored to source clean with .35 relative weight across the two disturbances.

notes: Test whether the companion proposal or the DURA likelihood update is responsible for the observed loss. The fused control is the prior complete method. Data-only sets the companion residual to zero, while keeping the two constrained CG steps and regularizer. Companion-only turns off the likelihood and uses the exact minimizer of that same prior alone.

All paths retain the same primary waveform, linear complex projection and raw correction norm cap 25%. LoRa primary is the fixed real-gain waveform, WiSig is original R69. This source source V comparison uses no new parameter updates and only clean and registered Full low urban.
Disjoint from earlier 192 screening packets by exact read-only frozen IDs. LoRa also excludes the earlier 300 V. WiSig known archive exposure is retained. Full target remains unchanged and unread.
